content.title: Olivia Rodrigo Announces New Album with a Surprising Title — See the Pretty-in-Pink Cover Art
content.text: NEED TO KNOW Olivia Rodrigo announced her third album You Seem Pretty Sad for a Girl So in Love, out June 12The album was recorded with producer Daniel Nigro, who worked on her chart-topping albums Sour and GutsRodrigo described the record as full of “sad love songs” to British Vogue No, it’s not just déjà vu — Olivia Rodrigo is back with a new album! The pop star, 23, announced her third record, You Seem Pretty Sad for a Girl So in Love, on Thursday, April 2. The album is set for release on June 12. “my third album ‘you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love’ is out June 12th,” Rodrigo wrote in an Instagram post. “I am so proud of this record and I can’t wait for you to hear it. available for preorder now! 🩷” The Grammy winner also shared the album’s cover, which features her upside down on a swing with a joyful expression on her face. You Seem Pretty Sad for a Girl So in Love was recorded with producer Daniel Nigro, who also collaborated with the star on her 2021 debut album Sour and its 2023 follow-up Guts, which both hit No. 1. Olivia Rodrigo's 'You Seem Pretty Sad for a Girl So in Love'. Courtesy Geffen Records In an interview with British Vogue, Rodrigo teased the direction of the new record, telling the outlet it was “a creative challenge to write from a joyful place.” “When you’re experiencing that you’re connected to someone, or feeling really good, you’re not in your head thinking about bittersweet poems!” said the star, who was previously linked to British actor Louis Partridge. Rodrigo later described the album’s track list as being full of “sad love songs,” explaining, “I realized all my favorite romantic love songs were beautiful because they had a tinge of fear or yearning in them.” Related Stories The “Vampire” singer also said one specific song aims to capture “what I think being in love feels like.” “You’re getting to the core of all of your issues: how you feel about yourself, your insecurities, what makes you joyful,” she said. “It feels like the most raw form of you, which is so scary and terrifying and uncomfortable, sometimes, but beautiful at times.” Rodrigo previously opened up to PEOPLE ahead of the release of Guts in 2023 about her songwriting process, and how she feared she’d be unable to top the monster success of her debut album. “I think that I truly can’t write a song and pander. Good songs don’t come out of me writing to please other people,” she said. “All my best songs come from me just wanting to express something for myself and wanting to process a feeling just for me. Putting that out is sort of a later thought, but at the inception of a song, it’s just very insular. I can’t think about the other stuff.” Since she came rip-roaring onto the scene with her 2021 breakthrough single “Drivers License,” Rodrigo has become one of pop music’s brightest stars, selling over 36 million albums worldwide and winning three Grammy Awards, including Best New Artist.
